subject: a walrus head built from folded map-like paper planes
pose: frontal head with one cheek fold lifted
art_direction: 海象头像由无字地图折面和粗墨块组成，短须如纸片、橘色鼻面突出，复古拼版感强烈。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Build a walrus head from folded paper planes printed only with abstract contour lines, never place names or text. Use broad charcoal ink masses for the eyes and whisker roots, a warm orange nose plane, and pale blue-gray cheek folds. Keep the tusks short, blunt, and ivory, reading as natural anatomy rather than dramatic points. One cheek fold lifts slightly, creating a solemnly funny asymmetry. The collage edges and a few paper overlaps remain visible, while the silhouette stays broad and compact. Place the head on a cream background with generous negative space. Center it for a circular crop, avoiding a body, ocean scene, labels, or excessive scraps.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
